title: Never issue a mutation-shaped operation over an observation channel
purpose: An observer/monitor stream is read-only by contract; control must enter only through the engine's own control path. An LLM observer must not be able to mutate the thing it observes via the observation interface.
trigger: An observation subscription, query router, or monitor-to-model interface accepts OR forwards a mutation-shaped verb (create, write, put, post, transact, commit, confirm, cancel, delete) instead of failing closed as OBSERVATION_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN.
correct: Accept only the read verbs (SNAPSHOT, CURRENT, BACK, HISTORY, KNOWN_STATE). Reject and surface any mutation-shaped operation as OBSERVATION_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN at the observation boundary.
evidence_note: Observation v0.2: ObservationQueryRouter accepts only read operations; mutation-shaped operations fail closed as OBSERVATION_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN. Observation never implies control.
